To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(a) the PI controller based SPS modulation technique has been used in order to obtain the desired performance in terms of high power transfer; (b) the simulation and experimental results of the PI controller based simple SPS controlled BIDC are presented to verify the proposed BIDCs; and (c) the proposed BIDCS are compared in terms of power transfer and efficiency.
the PI controller based SPS method has the lowest total harmonic distortion (THD) and the highest power transfer efficiency among the compared methods.
the PI controller based SPS modulation method is the best choice for the proposed BIDDC.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the design of a high power BIDC with high power transfer capability and low power loss, which has a wide application in the fields of electric vehicles, renewable energy systems, and energy storage systems.
the development and analysis of a high-power bidirectional DC-DC converter with a single phase-shift modulation technique.
the design, simulation, implementation, and testing of a high power BIDC for high power applications.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the PI controller based simple-phase shift controlled BIDC is the most suitable solution for high power applications.

the proposed PI controller based simple SPS controlled BIDC has the advantages of simple control scheme, high power transfer, high efficiency, low switching losses and low cost, which makes the proposed BIDIC suitable for high power applications.

PI controller based simple-phase-shift controlled BIDCs are more suitable for high power applications.

the PI based SPS controlled BIDC is capable to transfer power in both directions and it has the ability to achieve high power efficiency and high power transfer capability.
